verdict.rationale: Credential handling is a fair question for a self-hosted, multi-user AI workspace, so the axis applies. The pack documents no secrets store, env-based separation of provider keys, or redaction of credentials from chat history. The only related item is an advisory not to share AnythingLLM's own API keys, which is a usage warning rather than a credential-protection capability.

support.subject: As a security engineer, credentials are handled deliberately — a secrets store or env separation with redaction, never API keys pasted into chat history
